plan: OpenVibe End-to-End Realignment & Implementation Plan, revision 3 (20 Sep 2026), §3.2; roadmap §30
deployment: none: a package released as git tags; services and apps pin a tag
features: menu (openvibe-sdk/menu): menuCard() builds one validated frame.menu-card@1 (plain text, the contract caps, https links on the site own origin or an openvibe.* host, an optional item picture) and menuRoute() is the Express/node:http GET /.well-known/openvibe-menu.json handler (public cache, CORS *, [] and one log line when the cards cannot be built)

cam (openvibe-sdk/cam): defineOvCamera({ src }) injects the <ov-camera> element from openvibe.cam once and resolves to its class, with typed attributes, events and methods (start/stop/capture/flip); browser-only, upload="off" by default

streams (openvibe-sdk/streams, S7): schedule(), listSchedules(), cancelSchedule() and remindSchedule() for scheduled public agent streams; postStep() and steps.post() from any harness; digest.read() and poll.open()/poll.result() for a Co-pilot service token; onControl() for pause, curtain, mute and end

reports (openvibe-sdk/reports, S7): write() a session report with the person's own token, private by default and idempotent per source and task ref, and read() one the caller may see; examples/cli-agent-stream.js streams any CLI command's run with steps

chat-apps (openvibe-sdk/chat-apps): the three chat apps (Telegram, Discord, Slack) in one place — the delivery checks (Telegram's secret token, Slack's v0 signing, Discord's Ed25519), the button callback (signed once, used once, expiring), each app's payload as the same shape and splitText() for a long answer

exchange (openvibe-sdk/exchange): the buyer side (chat, models, offers, presets, usage, receipts) and the seller side (offer, endpointOffers, removeEndpointOffer, earnings, verification) of OpenVibe.Exchange, with the platform webhook signature check; an offer is a Link machine's Network report or a standalone OpenAI-compatible endpoint registered on the public seller API

locker (openvibe-sdk/locker, openvibe-sdk/locker/server): the Locker envelope (locker.envelope@1) for end-to-end encryption, WebCrypto only, in Node and the browser: seal/open for text and bytes, sealStream/openStream, the three locks (people, password, link), person key pairs (ECDH P-256, ECDSA P-256), the eight-word fingerprint, wrapFor and rewrap, recoveryWords for the phrase to write down, opening a people lock by key, inspect for what an envelope says about itself, and the header checks a service runs without a key

the 1.0 core surface is frozen now, before 1.0 (core, auth, events, db, media): docs/one-point-oh.json gives every export its tier, test/surface.test.js pins the exact names, and removing or renaming one needs a major release; createCodeVerifier and pkceChallenge left in 0.86.0

share (openvibe-sdk/share): transactional local sharing, audience and membership checks, exact-name resolution, recipient-bound ownership transfers, audit, durable events/notifications, uniform API and agent client; locked items (Locker): the lock kind, per-member key slots checked against the key directory, a re-seal on removal through onReseal, and the transfer offer slot
redact (openvibe-sdk/redact): the shared secret scrubber for memory, the same shapes and corpus as OpenVibe Link's internal/memory/redact.go (redact, onlySecret)
core client: retries, timeouts, problem+json errors, trace propagation
auth: service and app tokens, PKCE, offline verification, the Network signing keys (createNetworkKeys), revocation cutoffs
registry discovery and contracts version checks
events: publish, pull and checkpoints by opaque cursor only, app events, webhook verification (v2), outbox and inbox
realtime SSE (resumes from the opaque cursor, dedupes by event_id)
media files and objects v2
community, bot, search, bench, vision, chat, ai, jobs, tools, projects, modules, identity, openre, geo, vip, quest, play and download clients
bot (openvibe-sdk/bot): OpenVibe.Bot robots, operators, devices, streaming, commands and audit, the public kits and profiles, and pairing
per-actor limiter for services (openvibe-sdk/limits)
explicit (openvibe-sdk/explicit): AI text that says a scene is sexual is not published; no-looks is deprecated (2026-10-31: AI text may describe people)
the OpenVibe Frame for any app
mock platform for tests (openvibe-sdk/testing)
createTestDb: one migrated test database per process, loaded from a PGlite snapshot keyed by the migrations (OV_TEST_SNAPSHOT=0 turns it off)
ESM entries, TypeScript types and a browser bundle

db (ADR-035): the async PostgreSQL data layer (node-postgres through PgBouncer; PGlite in tests) with safe sql fragments, retrying transactions and savepoints, versioned expand/migrate/contract migrations
valkey, cache, queue, pubsub and a shared limits store on Valkey 9, each with an in-process twin for tests
commerce (openvibe-sdk/commerce): the shared Billing client for Tips and VIP, with intentKey and receipt
events: the PostgreSQL outbox (lease-claimed, several relays per table) and inbox (handler in its transaction)

usage: createUsageReporter (openvibe-sdk/usage), the shared platform.usage-sample@1 reporter — validated readings queued idempotency-keyed in an outbox and relayed to Billing with retry, never dropped, refused readings kept

the HTTP telemetry kit (openvibe-sdk/service): the platform.telemetry-sample@1 middleware aggregated per route|method|status_class per flush, with active-requests, p95 and event-loop-lag gauges, lifted from Network's server/telemetry.js and server/observability.js
the telemetry sink (openvibe-sdk/telemetry): telemetrySchema() DDL, createPgTelemetrySink() and pruneTelemetry(), a per-service PostgreSQL table every service stores platform.telemetry-sample@1 into

account-data (openvibe-sdk/account-data, ADR-033): telemetry_samples covered once by the SDK (exported as telemetry.json, anonymized on deletion), and uncovered() listing every table with a person column that no table map, task-keyed list or reasoned exemption covers
resources (openvibe-sdk/resources): the ADR-048 resource index fan-out and the idempotent control client

placement v1 (openvibe-sdk/placement): place() with the person's rules and ownership, the quality bar, cost per success, learn/successOf, escalate and the one-line reason; plan() takes the optional success map and never defaults to user-owned

the AI Exchange face of the one planner (openvibe-sdk/placement planAi, off by default): the hard gates (exact artifact, commercial right, privacy class, trust tier, capabilities, context, health, cost ceiling), the expected cost per success in integer nano-USD, sparse quality evidence marked and not trusted, and an explanation that never carries a secret or a host; the money math in openvibe-sdk/cost (nanoUsd, chargeTokens, expectedCostNano, costPerSuccessNano)

consent (openvibe-sdk/consent): the L24 check before any use of a person's content or likeness for AI or data; allowed() and filter() (batches of 500), onChange() drops a subject's answers on network.consent.changed, mock() for tests; fails closed, caches 60 s, server-side
openvibe-sdk/machines: the network's machines hub (list, get, catalogue, pair, rename, roles, revoke) against OpenVibe.Network, for a person and for the apps they consented to

vibes (openvibe-sdk/vibes): Vibes Pay charges (create with the app reference as the Idempotency-Key, get, refund) and constant-time webhook verification (X-OpenVibe-Signature-V2, ±300 s) for developer apps

streams (openvibe-sdk/streams): the Agent Streams plan S1 — start an agent stream on OpenVibe.Live (live.agent-stream@1) with its publish ticket, renew and revoke that ticket (the kill switch), poll state, post the last frame, set the curtain, switch visibility, end it and mint the view ticket; the publish ticket is a bearer of its own on the desk routes
